pulse.currentFocus: Session 333 root-caused and fixed a five-day public editorial outage: The Desk had failed eight consecutive scheduled publish runs because topic selection gave up after one topic whose only direct source answered 401, while six readable topics sat untried in the same queue. Selection now walks the ranked queue and spends its attempt budget per host rather than per story. The session also found that S332 regression lock for the previous scheduled-CI bug had never been wired into any runner, made it a build:check step, and replaced its single-script assertion with a structural invocation-mode detector. Canonical destination unknowns now carry a consecutive-unknown streak and a last-known-good age that can never promote a verdict.
pulse.nextMilestone: Confirm an unattended scheduled Desk publish lands a post-2026-08-30 edition, extend check-build-gate-reachability to every self-test-bearing module under scripts/ and scripts/lib/, and complete the separate founder-reserved Obelisk relying-party/passkey ceremony when it becomes available.
blockers: identity/auth surfaces remain held on real-provider-e2e-pending: obelisk.identity.verify is missing OBELISK_RP_ID, OBELISK_RP_NAME, and OBELISK_RP_ORIGIN; obelisk-staging-registration is also missing. The S332 candidate is blast-radius-disjoint and its scoped production resolver is allowed, which does not resolve or bypass this hold.

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S333][INFRA/P2] The `full` derived-build profile is not full: it omits `build-public-status.mjs`, so a closeout cascade leaves the public status surface stale. `DERIVED_BUILD_PROFILES.full` is the profile `closeout-autopilot` runs after context write-back, but `build-public-status.mjs` appears only in `refresh-live-data`. Observed live in S333: after regenerating `public-intelligence` and running the `full` profile to green preflight, `build-public-status --check` still failed at build:check step 140 because nothing in `full` re-derived it. A profile named `full` that is a strict subset of another profile is a naming trap, and the cascade is only ever as wide as its declared graph. Either make `full` a genuine superset, or derive both profiles from one dependency graph so a consumer cannot be reachable in one profile and orphaned in the other. Pairs with the S333 invocation-mode work: same file, same class of gap.

[S333][OBS/P3] The Desk freshness banner disagrees with its own API by one day, and its `--check` gate goes stale daily by design. `news/index.html` embeds a rendered relative age ("latest published evidence 2026-08-25 · 6 days old") while `api/news-desk-freshness.json` and the scheduled cron both report `age 5d` for the same date on the same day. Two separate issues: reconcile the arithmetic (likely a ceil/floor or UTC-boundary difference), and decide whether a time-relative string belongs in a byte-checked static page at all — as built, `generate-news-pages --check` reports drift every single day purely from the clock, which trains readers of that gate to treat real drift as routine.

[S333][SIL][OBS/P2] Audit every other fixed-size scan window against current automation churn. The forge ledger went blind because it scanned a fixed last-120 commits while `[skip ci]` publishers commit several times an hour. Any other producer that samples "the last N commits/rows/lines" and then filters is vulnerable to the same burial. Enumerate them, re-size each by what it is looking for rather than by a raw count, and add a gate that fails when a noise-filtered producer yields zero entries while the repo has recent human commits — zero-with-activity is the signature, and it is currently indistinguishable from a genuinely quiet repo.

[S333][SIL][NEWS/P1] Confirm The Desk actually resumes on its own schedule. The fix is proven locally and in a live drafting run, but the proof that matters is a scheduled `The Desk — Scheduled Publish` run going green without intervention and a new edition dated after 2026-08-30. Verify the next run; if it still drops, the next suspect is queue freshness (`news-trend-radar.mjs --scan`), not selection.

[S333][SIL][GATE/P1] Sweep for other orphaned self-tests. `build-order.mjs --self-test` passed 25/25 for sessions while being invoked by nothing. `check-build-gate-reachability.mjs` reports 246/246 reachable but did not consider `scripts/lib/*.mjs` self-tests, so its denominator excluded the orphan. Extend the reachability gate's corpus to every `--self-test`-bearing module under `scripts/` and `scripts/lib/`, then re-run — a gate whose denominator omits the orphan class cannot report the orphan.

[S330][UX/P0] Coordinate every automatic notification through one visitor-attention budget. ✅ Shared `VSAttention` claim covers consent, PWA install, exit intent, visit depth, returning digest, journey tour/feedback, and portal notices. Consent/onboarding reserve functional priority; returning visitors receive at most one automatic surface per tab; 30-day cooldowns prevent repeat nags. Contract 15/15; exact staging behavior 15/15 across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

[S330][MOBILE/P1] Repair narrow-screen footer dispatch containment and the membership interview skip target. ✅ Footer collapses safely at ≤430px; the interview skip affordance is an inline-flex 44px target and its dynamic source is bound into the 235-cell mobile receipt.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
